gen-press-start-2p-gf-epunda-slab: Press Start 2P spaces its blocky letters far apart, like cut-outs pinned to a board, with a swell you only notice up close. And Epunda Slab follows with tall, rounded lowercase and a gaping c, a dignified text serif that steadies the playfulness.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads like a literary classic serif, its tall middle band keeping ascenders and descenders shallow and the e's eye generously entered. And Press Start 2P, with its pinned-apart retro letters, gives that quiet texture a playful jolt above.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-glegoo: Press Start 2P brings pixel-style fun and far-spaced letters. Glegoo does the opposite job, offering a refined, editorial serif whose big counters and wide, unclosed curves make sustained text feel generous and easy.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-hanuman: Hanuman reads as a traditional, refined serif, its high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s giving text a stately look. But the pair's strongest quality is the jump in mood, since Press Start 2P brings fun, retro spacing above it.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-kadwa: Playful and retro, Press Start 2P leads with wide-spaced blocks. Kadwa follows in a classic serif with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height, so a long passage would feel editorial, spacious and unhurried.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noticia-text: Literary and dignified, Noticia Text pulls in each curve with a big visible entrance, its lowercase filling most of the letter height. But the pair's strongest quality is play against polish, as Press Start 2P adds retro, far-spaced fun.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla reads as a refined, authoritative text serif, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals and its e pried wide open. Press Start 2P is the strongest foil, a retro, pinned-apart display face that makes that authority feel even more composed.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-pridi: Refined and classic, Pridi gives its serif letters generous space between curve ends and stems, with small letters standing almost capital-sized. And the pair's strongest quality is spirited contrast, since Press Start 2P brings retro fun and far-spaced cut-out letters.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-scope-one: Traditional in mood, Scope One has counters spilling into the space around them, stubby ascenders and descenders, and a big x-height. Press Start 2P sits against that serif with retro, far-spaced letters, so the page gets fun above and refinement below.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px is a bookish text serif with large open counters in tall a, e and s, clear in every rounded letter. Press Start 2P does retro fun best; Slabo does steady reading.
